profile.name: Jeevan Reddy Ragula
profile.title: Principal Software Engineer & Architect
profile.headline: Architecting the Future of Cloud Security
profile.description: With 19 years of software engineering experience, I specialize in designing and scaling cloud-native security platforms and distributed systems. At Zscaler, I have been a core engineer and architect across Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC), DSPM, and AI Security initiatives. My work spans Go, Kubernetes, AWS, distributed data platforms, event-driven systems, and AI-native architectures.

products.title: AI Security / AI Asset Management
products.description: Architecting an AI security platform that brings together AI models, agents, MCP servers, workloads, AI identities and related assets across cloud and developer environments, with AI-native integrations and security workflows.
features: AI model, agent and workload inventory
AWS, Azure, GCP and GitHub integrations
Go, Kubernetes, Kafka and Redis-based services

products.title: Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
products.description: Core architect and engineer for distributed DSPM scanning workflows, covering dynamic data snapshots, cloud storage and database crawling, distributed scan execution, DLP integration, and results processing in a multi-tenant cloud environment.
features: Cloud data discovery across customer environments
Distributed file and database scanning workflows

products.title: Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC)
products.description: Core engineer and architect involved in building ZPC, a cloud security platform spanning cloud inventory, posture management, policy evaluation, IaC security, vulnerability workflows, and integrations across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes and developer platforms.

patents.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Scanner for Component Security
patents.description: A specialized scanning architecture that parses, compiles, and evaluates compliance and security policies against IaC blueprints (Terraform, CloudFormation) before deployment, shifting security left.

patents.name: Cloud-Based Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
patents.description: Systems and methods for discovering, classifying, and monitoring data assets across heterogeneous cloud services, evaluating compliance, and enforcing localized policy frameworks.

career: Leading architecture and core engineering across cloud security and AI security initiatives, including Zscaler Posture Control, DSPM and AI security platforms. Focus areas include Go microservices, Kubernetes, multi-cloud security, distributed data processing, and AI-native architectures.

Worked on cloud security product engineering, distributed services, event-driven systems and security technologies while contributing to the architecture and scale-up of Zscaler's cloud security platform.
Worked on the Cloud Connector team for a cloud access security broker (CASB) product, building cloud security services and integrations for enterprise environments.
IVY Software Development Services Pvt Ltd
Led engineering for a PCI DSS payment gateway platform for Entain, including payment integrations, high-volume transaction processing, Java/Spring-based services, and enterprise database systems.
Worked on HPE Serviceguard for Linux and related management software using Java and JavaScript.
Worked as an application developer in the automotive domain, building enterprise software using Java.
Bachelor of Technology in Electronics & Communication Engineering, completed at Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad.
